name: Morph Canvas
tagline: Barty-Bart's motion-broll: a warm grey canvas, white components, one orange, springs with a tiny overshoot, blur swaps.

motion.direction: Barty-Bart motion-broll. Motion-graphic B-roll timed to the words: one container that never cuts — content swaps by blurring out fast and blurring in after the beat; springs ζ 0.84–0.95 (a tiny overshoot, never a bounce); the camera zooms per state (cards ≈1.2–1.6×, pills 1.8–2.2×). Vocabulary: `chips` as pill + click, `lockCard` as a status island, `counter` with tabular numbers, `chapterCard`, `imageCard` as a card drag. One change per spoken beat 0.4–1.2 s apart; cutaways 3–10 s with ≥ 2 s of face between; never cut away in the first second or on an emotional line. Warm grey `stage`, white components, one orange `ter`; no gradients on chrome, no particles, no glows.
